pet_notes: Robin from Honkai: Star Rail as one compact full-body 2D chibi pet. Preserve silver-blue hair with long twin flowing locks and rear rosette bun, turquoise-to-violet gradient eyes, gold halo with three white trumpet-flower tips, small white feathered ear-wings, and the white/deep-indigo/lilac/gold off-shoulder layered stage dress with gloves and blue heels. Gentle poised singer personality. No microphone stand, base, text, logos, scenery, or detached decorative effects.
style_notes: Polished clean anime chibi sticker illustration with crisp dark indigo linework, soft cel shading, large expressive eyes, compact two-head-tall proportions, readable simplified costume motifs, and consistent full-body silhouette at pet size.
